Name: Custom Ore Nodes
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod allows you to create custom ore nodes that have a chance to spawn instead of ordinary stones (similar to other ore nodes). By default it includes a new "coal stone" node that drops coal and has examples of a "pizza stone" that drops pizza and a rainbow stone that drops prismatic shards.


[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]

To use this mod, target "aedenthorn.CustomOreNodes/dict" using Content Patcher, with the following syntax:

[code]{
    "Format": "2.7.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "LogName": "PizzaStone",
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.CustomOreNodes/dict",
            "Entries": {
                "{{ModId}}_PizzaStone": {
                    "itemId": "{{ModId}}_PizzaStone",
                    "dropItems": [
                        {
                            "itemIdOrName": "206",
                            "dropChance": 100.0,
                            "minAmount": 1,
                            "maxAmount": 2,
                            "luckyAmount": 1,
                            "minerAmount": 1
                        }
                    ],
                    "oreLevelRanges": [
                        {
                            "minLevel": -1,
                            "maxLevel": -1,
                            "spawnChanceMult": 1.0,
                            "expMult": 1.0,
                            "dropChanceMult": 1.0,
                            "dropMult": 1.0,
                            "minDifficulty": -1,
                            "maxDifficulty": -1
                        }
                    ],
                    "spawnChance": 1.0,
                    "durability": 2,
                    "exp": 12
                }
            }
        },
        {
            "LogName": "PizzaStoneObject",
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "Data/Objects",
            "Entries": {
                "{{ModId}}_PizzaStone": {
                    "Name": "{{ModId}}_PizzaStone",
                    "Name": "Stone",
                    "DisplayName": "Pizza Stone",
                    "Description": "Pizza Stone",
                    "Type": "Litter",
                    "Category": -999,
                    "SpriteIndex": 206,
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}
[/code]

[size=5][b]Node Explanation[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]itemId[/b]: the node item to display in world, corresponding to a custom object in [b]Data/Objects[/b]
[*][b]dropItems[/b]: the list of items to drop (see below)
[*][b]oreLevelRanges[/b]: the list of mine level ranges on which this ore node can spawn (see below)
[*][b]nodeDesc[/b]: describe your ore node.
[*][b]spawnChance[/b]: the base percent chance that each ordinary ore node will be this type of ore
[*][b][/b][b]durability[/b]: how hard it is to break this node
[*][b]exp[/b]: how much exp gained for breaking this node
[/list]
The object referenced in [b]Data/Objects[/b] must have a category of -999 and its name must be "Stone", so you need to add a custom object as above.


[size=4][b]Drop Item List[/b][/size]

The drop item list contains JSON objects with information on what items this node should drop as follows:

[list]
[*][b]itemIdOrName[/b]: Object index or name of item (see Raw data [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Object_data#Raw_data]here[/url]﻿ for object ids and names)
[*][b]dropChance[/b]: % Chance to drop this item
[*][b]minAmount[/b], [b]maxAmount[/b]: Minimum amount to drop, maximum amount to drop
[*][b]luckyAmount[/b]: Additional amount to drop if lucky
[*][b]minerAmount[/b]: Additional amount to drop if skilled miner
[/list]

[b][size=4]Level Range List[/size][/b]

The level range list contains JSON objects that specify ranges of mine floors this node can spawn on as follows:

[list]
[*][b]minLevel[/b],[b]maxLevel[/b]: set either to [b]-1[/b] to disable it; 121 is the first Skull Cave level; 0 means outside of the mines (0,0 means only outside of the mines)
[*][b]spawnChanceMult[/b]: a multiplier for this range of the base chance of this node spawning
[*][b]expMult: [/b]a multiplier for this range of the base exp for mining this node
[*][b]dropMult: [/b]a multiplier for this range of the base amount of each item dropping from node
[*][b]dropChanceMult[/b]: a multiplier for this range of the base chance of each item dropping from node
[*][b]minDifficulty[/b], [b]maxDifficulty[/b]: new to SDV 1.5, mines can get harder. Set either of these to 1 if you only want it to spawn on harder levels. Set to -1 to disable.
[/list]
The node listed above translates into a 5% chance per stone of spawning a coal stone instead in the mines (levels 1-120).

[size=5][b]Technical Notes[/b][/size]

If you are trying to drop items from mods that you don't know the id for, just use the object name (but not the display name if it's different).

The SMAPI log now shows better messages to tell you when something's wrong with your syntax. Check it if you are having trouble.

The screenshots were created using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5894]Custom Dungeon Floors[/url] which allows for spawning more stones, among other things.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Source code is available at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
